slides.title: US calls for justice over Arsi killings
Protect civilians. Independent investigations.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: US State Dept. Bureau of African Affairs, via Ethiopian Business View, Oct 31, 2026

card.title: “Such horrific attacks against any group must stop.”
card.body: US State Department, Bureau of African Affairs, on reported targeted killings of civilians in Arsi Zone, Oromia. It urged Ethiopia's government to investigate and hold those responsible to account.
